description: You are a disease surveillance coordinator who needs to create a case report form and enter Hepatitis B case data using Epi Info 7. This task requires using THREE different Epi Info modules in sequence. STEP 1 - MakeView: Open the MakeView module (via the main Epi Info launcher or Modules menu). Create a new Epi Info project called 'HepBSurveillance' at C:\Users\Docker\Documents\HepBSurveillance.prj. In the MakeView editor, create a form called 'CaseReport' with the following fields: CaseID (Text, 10 chars), ReportDate (Date), County (Text, 30 chars), Sex (Text, 10 chars), AgeAtDiagnosis (Number, integer), HBsAg_Positive (Yes/No), Anti_HBc_Positive (Yes/No), HBeAg_Status (Text, 10 chars), SourceOfInfection (Text, 50 chars), VaccinationStatus (Text, 20 chars), ClinicalStatus (Text, 20 chars). STEP 2 - Enter: Switch to the Enter module and open the HepBSurveillance project. Enter exactly 8 case records using the form you created. Use realistic Hepatitis B case data (vary the County, Sex, Age, infection source, vaccination status, and clinical status across cases). STEP 3 - Analysis: Switch to Classic Analysis. READ the HepBSurveillance CaseReport table. Run ROUTEOUT to C:\Users\Docker\hepb_analysis.html REPLACE. Run FREQ on Sex, County, SourceOfInfection, VaccinationStatus, and ClinicalStatus. Run MEANS on AgeAtDiagnosis. Close ROUTEOUT. The project file C:\Users\Docker\Documents\HepBSurveillance.prj and the analysis HTML must both exist when done.

metadata.workflow: 3-step: MakeView (create form) → Enter (enter 8 records) → Analysis (FREQ + MEANS + ROUTEOUT)
